Proof for WLOG[edit]

The following assumption made on solution 2 can be done with a generality proof, and is quite simple.

If we have \( x = 10^a \) and \( y = 10^b \), we know that \( xy = 10^{a+b} \). Then, because is commutative and so are the powers, it doesn't matter which one of \( a \) and \( b \) is greater. Thus, we may safely assume \( a < b \) (or vice versa), and continue.

Optionally, in a proof contest, you could also show that both and work as valid cases, and provide the same answer.

~Pinotation
